candidate: Local working tree based on edd393bb; not deployed; new stage not committed.
scope: Local source changes, synthetic PostgreSQL and loopback HTTP only. Backup work remains deferred.
method: Synthetic loopback HTTP against the real Express app and migrated PostgreSQL. Authentication validates persisted hashed sessions through requireAuth; password login is not exercised. First-process samples use a fresh API process per request, with warm database pages and process imports excluded. Warm requests mix surfaces, profiles and two sessions per profile under a bounded shared concurrency. Client timing includes response-body receipt; server timing includes authentication and serialization. Active-pool interval samples are observations, not individual query wait times. No Nginx, TLS, browser rendering, external API or production load is measured.

measurementDesign.cohorts: Three sequential bounded cohorts; baseline application archived from Git, same installed dependencies and equivalent fixture volumes. Current benchmark harness used for all cohorts.
measurementDesign.postgres: PostgreSQL 16, one CPU, 768 MiB, disposable loopback-only container.
measurementDesign.pontoConsumers: Full baseline represents both previous consumers. Summary serves the cost table with identical displayed values/months. Reconciliation serves import-name matching and deliberately does not calculate costs.
measurementDesign.latencyComparison: Sequential, not paired or randomized; timing observations do not prove universal speedup or production acceptance.
measurementDesign.coldSamples: One fresh API process per route/profile; cold p95 suppressed. Database pages and module import time excluded from cold latency.

assertions: Exact complete member and grouped-detail equality with unbatched assembly, including Decimal monetary sums and manual costs.
Two Omie monetary batches across group members, including empty member; one fallback annual catalog per request.
Admin-only flag mismatch and division reject reuse of unscoped shared sources.
Worker source changes visible in next group request without new cross-request cache.
Full default contract preserved; every exposed summary field/month equals full calculation.
Reconciliation succeeds while report.findMany throws; metadata equals full response minus rates.
Unauthenticated 401, wrong-module 403, viewer 200, invalid view 400; new unmatched name visible after write.

frontend.newTest: Actual API clients and QueryClient verify view parameters, distinct caches and shared-prefix invalidation.

backend.execution: Full suite run by itself after combined-suite resource-contention timeout; existing WASM test passed without code/timeout changes.

initialCombinedSuite.reason: Existing PostgreSQL WASM transaction-isolation test exceeded 30 s under simultaneous backend/frontend execution; isolated rerun passed in 5.5 s. No timeout/configuration change.

validation.ci: YAML parsed; new parity step is sequential after HTTP harness tests in dedicated PostgreSQL job.

limitations: Synthetic local workload; no Nginx, TLS, browser rendering, external APIs or production load.
Warm active-pool no-queue observations improved from 22.4% to 24.9% (summary) and 29.7% (reconciliation), still below 95%; peak waiting did not decrease (43,43,44).
Individual admin detail p95 was about 4.5% slower in summary cohort; no universal latency improvement claimed.
Cost-table summary reduces serialization/transfer, not its 40 database calls or financial calculation.
Refresh completion time starts after worker writes are acknowledged and the sampling phase prepared, not at exact database commit timestamp.
Cards use existing cache expiry; immediate freshness is not asserted for cards.
Reports and report-collaborator queries remain per member to preserve existing source order and attribution behavior.
nextLocalWork: Reduce remaining group report/collaborator reads and cost-table calculation pressure, with exact financial/access/freshness parity; no new indexes justified by current SQL plans.
